title: Epley Maneuver
desc: Particle repositioning maneuver for posterior canal BPPV. ~80% effective on first treatment.

blocks.content: Confirm positive Dix-Hallpike first identifying the affected ear.
STOP if Dix-Hallpike shows central red flags: non-fatigable, purely vertical, or direction-changing nystagmus. Do not proceed with Epley.
(1) Dix-Hallpike right — head turned 45° right, lay back with head hanging. Wait for nystagmus to fully resolve.
(2) Rotate head 90° to the left, still hanging off table. Hold 30 seconds.
(3) Roll the entire body to the left, face now pointing toward the floor. Hold 30 seconds.
(4) Slowly sit up with chin tucked slightly down.
Observe patient seated 3–5 minutes before standing
Mild residual unsteadiness for the day is normal
Provide home Epley handout for recurrent cases
